product_one_liner.value: DataGrail is an AI-powered privacy platform for privacy, legal, and security teams that discovers personal data, automates privacy requests and assessments, manages consent, and controls privacy risk.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing or plan page was found; the site directs prospective buyers to contact or book a demo.

eng_blog.notes: Its engineering archive includes technical posts on property-based CRUD testing and API integration design, rather than only marketing posts.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists four roles: Senior Customer Success Manager, IT & Business Systems Manager, Senior Demand Generation Manager, and Senior Product Marketing Manager; none meets the specified AI/ML title criteria.

model_provider.notes: The public documentation identifies this as the model stack for Vera.

compliance_certs.notes: The company explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA Compliant, and GDPR Compliant; HIPAA and GDPR are compliance claims, not formal certifications.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest publicly documented round was October 12, 2022, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live board has four openings and no qualifying sales titles; an older Enterprise Account Executive URL now redirects to the current board.

launched_6mo.notes: Assessment AutoFill was introduced May 20, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: VP of Security Chris Deibler announced that April 29, 2026 was his last day at DataGrail.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The demand-generation role describes existing HubSpot ownership and its Salesforce sync; optional Marketo/Pardot experience is not treated as proof of use.
